target_semantics: 目标blend必须穿过支撑面内曲率半径小于blend半径的区域；分别验证完全紧角和仅壁面内部紧角，不能用R2小于R3.5的通过代替。

trigger.partial_admission: measure actual principal curvature radius at support region traversed by blend; recipe section radius or global curvature minimum alone is insufficient

named_constraints.geometric_segments: rounded rectangle 73x53 R10 represented as splines

insufficiency: 现全高型R2通过只为普通小R；R4/R8和部分紧型失败须保留。本case局部曲率law为重建推定，必须实测实际接触区域而非单报输入R3.5。
gaps: 需要原生inside_tight/repair组合的实际控制路径；普通圆角返回有效但绕开tight区域不通过。
部分紧型输入本身有C0/交换校验风险；输入无效时不得判目标算法失败。
functional_pass_rule: All case-specific admission gates AND all applicable geometry/feature oracles must pass. If required source mapping or mode meaning is not frozen, classify case_spec_incomplete; ordinary probes may still report their independent outcomes.
